name: OVHcloud Object Storage
tagline: S3-compatible High Performance Object Storage hosted in European OVHcloud datacenters.

instructions.navBreadcrumb: OVHcloud Control Panel › Public Cloud › Storage › Users & S3 Credentials
instructions.step1: Log into OVHcloud Manager and select your Public Cloud project.
instructions.step2: Under Storage, create an S3 user and copy the generated Access Key and Secret Key.
instructions.step3: Enter your regional S3 endpoint (e.g. https://s3.gra.cloud.ovh.net) and bucket name.

fields.label: Bucket Name (Optional)
fields.helper: Target bucket name (leave empty to mount all buckets)

fields.helper: Generated under Public Cloud > Storage > S3 Users
